review_result.summary: The provided HTML code for the arcade Snake game is well-structured and readable. However, there are some potential issues and improvements that can be made.

issues.description: The eatSound and gameOverSound variables are not being properly cleaned up, which can cause memory leaks.
issues.suggestion: Add a line to stop and disconnect the sound sources when they are no longer needed.

issues.description: The game logic is tightly coupled with the rendering logic. It would be better to separate these concerns into different functions or classes.
issues.suggestion: Consider using a more modular approach to organize the code.

issues.description: The code uses the localStorage API to store the high score, which can be vulnerable to XSS attacks if not properly sanitized.
issues.suggestion: Make sure to sanitize the high score value before storing it in localStorage.

issues.description: The code uses magic numbers (e.g., 400, 10) which can make the code harder to understand and maintain.
issues.suggestion: Consider defining constants for these values to make the code more readable and maintainable.
